title: C.E. 2471.049 — the denial reaches the ward
notes: Episode 06, from the other side of the counter. The CENSUS scene records what the accounting did; this records where it lands. A roll audit removes the unrolled from eligibility before a clinician has seen any of them, so the refusal is not a triage decision that went badly — no triage decision was made about them at all. The model refuses the criterion outright: whether a person is counted is not a clinical fact and cannot be written in a record anyone would sign.
